description: List the remote posts the calling tenant has registered: audio posts whose records live in repos Antiphony doesn't host. Only what was registered is listed; Antiphony does not crawl.

main.description: Returns a cursor-paginated page of the calling tenant's registered remote posts, newest first by the record's `createdAt`. Every filter is optional and they combine. Shaped after com.atproto.repo.listRecords: `limit` and `cursor` in, a named array and `cursor` out.

repo.description: Only records held in this DID's repo: the URI's authority for a repo record, the author segment for a space record.

space.description: Only records in this space, as a space URI: at://{authority}/space/{type}/{skey}.

kind.description: Only prompts, or only replies. Any other value is refused.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: the `cursor` from the previous page. Opaque.
Cursor for the next page. Absent on the last page.

errors.name: InvalidCursor
errors.description: The cursor is not one this method issued.
